race.comment: CASHOUT (5) looks the one to beat. He was a dominant winner at Pakenham Synthetic first up before looking the winner in the straight at Sandown Hillside last time, run down by Veyepee who flew home and has won dominantly again since. That looks great form and he'll be very hard to catch around here. LET IT BEEL (8) presents third up having won well fresh before a strong closing second at Sale. He won his only go this track and trip and will take plenty of holding out. LYRICS 'N' SONG (9) didn't handle the going fresh when well beaten, bouncing back with a strong win at Seymour last time. She can go on with it. KINGSBURY (16) was good fresh at Geelong and has plenty of scope to improve. CASTELLITO (10) is racing well and maps for every hope.
